sense: a defender of a person or a cause

terms.gloss: one who lays legal claim to a thing; hence a defender, protector, deliverer; also an avenger, a punisher
evidence: Cic. Leg. 3.39: habeat sānē populus tabellam quasi vindicem lībertātis (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: habeat sānē populus tabellam quasi vindicem lībertātis
phrases.english: by all means let the people have the ballot as, so to speak, the defender of its liberty
